system.title: System Preference
system.focusOnNewTabHint: A new tab reloads once so the search box can take focus from the address bar. The address bar then shows the extension's address.
system.showHitokotoHint: When on, each new tab requests a quote from hitokoto.cn. When off, Islet runs fully offline.

about.title: About Islet
about.content:
A minimalist and elegant browser start page. 
Crafted with care by Talyra42.
Contributor: Riven.
about.sites: Islet ships {count} PR-reviewed official websites so you can skip the pirated and phishing look-alikes in search results. Type /github to jump straight there, /gh?user=xx&repo=yy for a specific page, or tags:dev to filter by category (tags:tool{'|'}code matches either).
about.keys: Shortcuts: Ctrl+K focus search · Ctrl+Enter flip open mode · Ctrl+, toggle settings · Alt+Enter choose backup address · Shift+Enter open in new window · Esc close

MainSearchBar.empty: Type and press Enter to search...
MainSearchBar.emptyWithSites: Type to search, start with / for official sites...
